lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary vertical alignment of four high-intensity circular clusters is visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit. Further posterior, a secondary set of at least six large, high-luminance blobs is arranged in a roughly rectangular 2D array spanning the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of similar luminance to create a grid-like pattern. High-luminance circular blobs are positioned at the nodal intersections of these bands, most prominently in the zone behind the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible on the mid-flank. The most prominent ridge originates superior to the pectoral fin insertion and follows a straight horizontal trajectory toward the posterior, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the top edge and lower luminance (shadow) on the bottom.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots that are markedly smaller in diameter and more closely packed than the primary constellations on the lateral flank.
